```{python import-libraries-and-custom-functions}
#| echo: false

import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import Markdown
from itables import show

import custom_diff_functions as diff
```

```{python make-diff-table-tabs}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| warning: false

for i in comparisons:
    print('# ' + comparisons[i]['name'] + '\n\n')
    base = diff.read_multi_gpkg(comparisons[i]['original'])
    modified = diff.read_multi_gpkg(comparisons[i]['changed'])
    layer_diff = diff.check_layer_match(base, modified)
    colnames = diff.check_colname_match(base, modified)
    col_dtypes = diff.check_dtype_match(base, modified)
    row_summary = diff.summarize_row_changes(base, modified)
    deletions = diff.find_deleted_rows(base, modified)
    insertions = diff.find_inserted_rows(base, modified)
    updates = diff.find_updated_rows(base, modified)
    for j in deletions:
        deletions[j] = pd.DataFrame(deletions[j])
    for j in insertions:
        insertions[j] = pd.DataFrame(insertions[j])
    for j in updates:
        updates[j] = pd.DataFrame(updates[j])
    if all([layer_diff.empty, len(colnames) == 0, len(col_dtypes) == 0, row_summary.empty, len(deletions) == 0, len(insertions) == 0, len(updates) == 0]):
        print('No differences found.')
        continue
    print('::: {.panel-tabset} \n\n')
    print('## Summary\n\n')
    print('::: {.panel-tabset}\n')
    if not layer_diff.empty:
        print('### Different Layers')
        show(layer_diff)
    if len(colnames) > 0:
        print('### Different Column Names')
        print('::: {.panel-tabset}\n')
        for j in colnames:
            print('#### ' + j + '\n\n')
            show(colnames[j])
        print('\n\n:::\n')
    if len(col_dtypes) > 0:
        print('### Different Column Data Types')
        print('::: {.panel-tabset}\n')
        for j in col_dtypes:
            print('#### ' + j + '\n\n')
            show(col_dtypes[j])
        print('\n\n:::\n')
    if not row_summary.empty:
        print('### Summary of Row Changes')
        show(row_summary)
    print('\n\n:::\n')
    if len(deletions) > 0:
        print('\n\n## Deleted Rows\n\n')
        print('::: {.panel-tabset}\n')
        for j in deletions:
            print('### ' + j + '\n\n')
            show(deletions[j])
        print('\n\n:::\n')
    if len(insertions) > 0:
        print('\n\n## Inserted Rows\n\n')
        print('::: {.panel-tabset}\n')
        for j in insertions:
            print('### ' + j + '\n\n')
            show(insertions[j])
        print('\n\n:::\n')
    if len(updates) > 0:
        print('\n\n## Updated Rows\n\n')
        print('::: {.panel-tabset}\n')
        for j in updates:
            print('### ' + j + '\n\n')
            show(updates[j], allow_html = True)
        print('\n\n:::\n')
    print('\n\n:::')
```
